cohort: 104 pregnant women with β-thal/HbE disease and 1040 randomly selected pregnant women with low-risk pregnancies
finding: Pregnant women with β-thal/HbE disease had a significantly increased risk of fetal growth restriction, preterm birth, low birth weight, and cesarean delivery compared to women with low-risk pregnancies.
mod_finding: Cesarean rate was significantly higher in the study group.
gest_age: Mean gestational age was significantly lower in the study group.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was significantly lower in the study group.
